title: S3 contract-design boundary — BE/FE contracts (befe-contract-design output)
description: Boundary for the S3 contract-design node: permissive superset over befe-contract-design/schemas/output.json; required mirrors the YAML required_fields [contract_spec, fe_state_binding, audit_id]. contract_spec and fe_state_binding are structured objects as of skill 0.2.0 (summary + documents[] / states).

contract_spec.description: Structured single source of truth: {summary, documents[]{kind, context, path}}.

bff.description: Present only when client classes differ; never null.

fe_state_binding.description: Structured FE state binding: {summary, states{loading,empty,error}, optimistic?, documents[]?}.

contract_files.description: Per-context emitted contract artifact refs (be/ OpenAPI summaries, fe/ state bindings).
